# Rosyorovx service runbook

Rosyorovx is an internal service owned by the Storage team.

## Data retention

The retention period for Rosyorovx logs is 365 days. After that period the records are deleted automatically.

## Hosting

Rosyorovx runs in the ca-central region. Changes to this service follow the standard review process and are announced in the engineering channel.

## Security

Rosyorovx encrypts data at rest using AES-128. Keys are rotated every 3 months. Dashboards for latency and error budgets are linked from the internal portal.

## Operations

Support for Rosyorovx is provided by a follow-the-sun rotation. Backups are verified by restoring them into an isolated environment.
